mandatory_future_validator_algorithms.identity_kind_closure: Enumerate every schema property whose name ends _identity plus every bare identity property; require an identity_kind_by_field entry, enforce its exact kind or allowed_kinds/null predicate, enforce bare_identity_kind_by_enclosing_schema, policy_identity_kind_by_iam_action, and resource_identity_kind_by_action. Reject missing, surplus, unknown, generic-ref, or aws_account_identity/v1 substituted runtime identities.
mandatory_future_validator_algorithms.operator_bootstrap_pass: For PASS require every root_action_observation disposition SUCCEEDED with null failure_code, exact resource kind by API action, exactly one successful sts:AssumeRole, no action outside packet arrays or maxima, nonnull exact role/policy/session/expiry, null rollback, observed_utc strictly before session expiry, and role readback equal packet target.
mandatory_future_validator_algorithms.preparation_pass_actions: Require exactly ten action observations in phase_order and sequence order 0..9, each SUCCEEDED with nonnull started/completed UTC, started_utc<=completed_utc, exact action-specific resource kind, and no omitted, duplicate, unknown, FAILED, ROLLED_BACK, or NOT_STARTED item.
mandatory_future_validator_algorithms.preparation_pass_bootstrap: Require initial/final stopped, exactly one start and SSM command, at least one bounded stop, nonnull OS/version/architecture/type, exact Docker 29.7.2 and AWS CLI 2.36.36, exact packet image digest, zero container runs, nonnull started/stopped UTC with started_utc<stopped_utc, and all observations within packet deadline/call/resource maxima.
mandatory_future_validator_algorithms.preparation_cost_arithmetic: Recompute integer upper_bound_minor_units from the sealed cost model and observed resource use; require within_ceiling equals (upper_bound_minor_units<=ceiling_minor_units), both ceiling values equal the packet, and PASS only when the comparison is true.
mandatory_future_validator_algorithms.timestamp_ordering: Parse every UTC value; require authorization observed after its complete packet, every action before its deadline, operator session expiry after bootstrap closure and preparation deadline, live packet assumer expiry after packet observation and second-approval window, live authorization execution_session_expires_utc strictly greater than live authorization observed_utc, and all launch/cleanup/attempt deadlines in declared order.
mandatory_future_validator_algorithms.live_effect_policy_operability: Canonicalize the exact template and change-set diff into closed effect API/resource records; because cloudformation_role_identity is null, require every underlying create/update/delete/read/tag and rollback action in the live session policy. Require iam:PassRole exactly when Lambda or Step Functions Role properties consume the exact template-derived execution roles, forbid PassRole on every other role, and prove the final session policy is a subset of both ceiling and base policy.
mandatory_future_validator_algorithms.conditional_failure_semantics: Require FAIL/INCONCLUSIVE typed nonnull phase/code and forbid advancement; require START_ACCEPTED exact runtime identity kinds plus nonnull docker container and null failure fields; require refused/failed start null container unless an observed container existed and nonnull typed failure fields.
